attacks.name: Knobkerrie
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pursuit|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.
|!critical| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Push the defender Away |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Wrath of the Jabari
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it |!movement_medium|.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Avalanche|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|. It may then make a |*Knobkerrie| attack targeting a different enemy character.

superPowers.name: Blessed by Ghekre (Affiliation: Wakanda)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, when an allied character is Contesting an objective token and would be Pushed or Placed by an enemy effect, roll a die. If the result is a |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block|, the character is not Pushed or Placed.|\|Additionally, once per Turn, when an allied character makes an attack, if there are 1 or more |!wild| results in its attack roll, it may change 1 die result to a |!hit|.

superPowers.name: Strength of the White Gorilla
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Chieftain of the Jabari
superPowers.body: This character cannot be Pushed or Advanced by the special effects of |!physical| or |!energy| attacks from characters of |!size| 3 or less.

superPowers.name: Solid Frame
superPowers.body: This character does not suffer |!damage| from collisions with other characters.
